AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Homemade Sun Dryer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Animal Feed: Hay and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
